name: reconciliation
title: Account reconciliation
for_each: select r.id, pl.label||' '||a.code||' '||a.name as name from reconciliations r join accounts a on a.id=r.account_id join period_list pl on pl.id=r.period_id order by pl.label, a.code

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select pl.entity, pl.month, a.code, a.name as account, a.risk, pl.currency from reconciliations r join accounts a on a.id=r.account_id join period_list pl on pl.id=r.period_id where r.id=$1

sections.title: Reconciliation
sections.sql: select rs.ledger_balance, rs.supporting_balance, rs.open_items, rs.unexplained, rs.balance, case when rs.balance_moved then 'yes' else 'no' end as moved_since_prepared from recon_status rs where rs.reconciliation_id=$1

sections.title: Reconciling items
sections.sql: select dated, description, kind, amount, cleared_on from recon_items where reconciliation_id=$1 order by dated

sections.title: Sign-off
sections.sql: select state, prepared_by, prepared_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, evidence, reject_reason from reconciliations where id=$1

name: close-report
title: Month-end close report
for_each: select id, label as name from period_list order by entity, period_end

sections.title: Status
sections.sql: select cs.state, cs.business_days_in, cs.target_close, cs.days_to_close, cs.tasks_finished||'/'||cs.tasks as tasks, cs.recs_reviewed||'/'||cs.recs_needed as reconciliations, cs.journals_unposted, cs.flux_unexplained, cs.closed_by from close_status cs join period_list pl on pl.label=cs.period where pl.id=$1

sections.title: Checklist
sections.sql: select name as task, owner, reviewer, state, done_by, signed_off_by from tasks where period_id=$1 order by sort

sections.title: Reconciliations
sections.sql: select code, account, balance, state, unexplained, prepared_by, reviewed_by from recon_status where period_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Manual journals
sections.sql: select reference, kind, description, state, debits, approved_by, ledger_ref from journal_status where period=(select label from period_list where id=$1) order by reference

sections.title: Variance commentary
sections.sql: select code, account, change, change_pct, coalesce(explanation,'Not explained') as explanation from flux where period=(select label from period_list where id=$1) and (needs_explaining or explanation is not null) order by abs(change) desc
